d: Long, flowing champagne blonde hair with straight bangs and a side-parted fringe is held back by a black headband. The eyes are a vivid ruby red with a sharp, stern expression, set on a youthful face. A slender build is dressed in a white ruffled strapless dress featuring a high white collar accented by a deep crimson ribbon tie. Signature details include long, dangling ruby-red drop earrings and a black feathered accessory attached to the back of the head.
